messages.subject: [S] shewhart graph problem
messages.body_plain:
Dear Users,

	i would like to ask how to add new control limits in the shewhart chart 
plot(beside the 3sigma control limits) which is run by >shewhart(qcc,....) 
in S-plus. considering some 'warning' limits i want to add to apply a 
variable sampling limits and intervals.

and also how to change the title and do some modification in the graph.

Would you mind helping me solve this problem?

Thanks Very Much.

Regards,
Hendry Raharjo

Surabaya
Indonesia.

messages.subject: [S] EXCEL-S-plus Problems...rsvp
messages.body_plain:
Dear Users,

	i am a university graduate doing research in optimality design to apply 
some quality technology theories in a company. So far, i am using  GRG 
(Generalized Reduced Gradient) procedure to solve my problems with the 
constraints available which are mostly nonlinear.

	i have been using Excel Solver to help me run the iteration since S-PLUS 
cannot do this GRG2. i got stuck when i want to produce an inverse of a 
matrix, which is indispensable to the formula constructed ,in MS-EXCEL. i 
wonder if the Excel Solver can be used in S-PLUS or we can have matrix 
property in EXCEL which is 'imported' from S-PLUS.

	Could you please help me?

	i am looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Thanks in advanced.

Regards,

Hendry Raharjo
Industrial Engineering Dept.
Petra Christian University
Surabaya
Indonesia.
